# components

**In one sentence:** The building blocks of the Upscale Review modal: the frame, one section per size tier, image cards, and the detail panel.

## Why it exists
Upscale Review shows every image that could be upscaled or cleaned up, grouped by size. You can decide for a whole size group at once or for one image. Each visual piece lives here so `../upscale_review.js` only has to connect them.

## What's inside
| File | What it does |
|---|---|
| `modal.js` | `upscaleReviewModal(itemCount, tierCount)` builds the modal with a header, a grid on the left and a detail panel on the right. |
| `tier_section.js` | `upscaleTierSection(tier, cards, { onUpscaleAll, onKeepSize })` makes one tier block. It has a header you can click to collapse it, an "Upscale all" button, a "Keep size" button, and a grid of the tier's cards. |
| `card.js` | `upscaleReviewCard` is a thumbnail card built on the shared `components/review_card.js` (left-click shows details, right-click cycles only the decisions allowed for that image). `syncUpscaleCards` refreshes the decision styling on every card. |
| `detail.js` | `renderUpscaleDetail(detail, item, decisions, onChange)` draws the large preview, the decision buttons, and the numbers: size, shortest side, tier, highlight threshold, target, and planned action. If there are no images, it shows an empty message. |

## How it works
- The frame is built first. Then a tier section per group fills `.upscale-review-grid`, and each section holds its cards.
- Clicking a decision button in the detail panel writes into the shared `decisions` object, then calls `onChange` so the cards and the panel redraw.

## Who uses it
- `../upscale_review.js`: the only importer.
- Shared code: `static/core/dom.js` (`escapeText`), `static/components/review_card.js`.
- Tests: `tests/ui/static/upscale_review.test.js`.
